prompt:
Create one isolated transparent-background pixel-art BOTTOM principal view, camera directly below looking straight up, of the same old Havana colonial arcade building in the canonical source. The attached labeled source and accepted FRONT/TOP/RIGHT/LEFT/REAR views are authoritative for building identity, actual footprint, material, and scale; ignore/reconstruct past the held old bottom view because it is a frontal balcony fragment.

BOTTOM must be a true underside projection of the complete building footprint, with the same broad XY outline/depth as the TOP plan. Show a coherent warm cream/ochre masonry foundation underside or timber support soffit matching the source construction, with compact support/piers visible only as cross-sections at their actual positions. The front balcony, arches, columns, windows and vertical facade must be occluded from below; do not show any upright facade, balcony rail, arch opening, column shaft, roof top, or frontal scene. No generic metal tray, bolts, or invented ornament. Preserve source-appropriate plaster/stone/timber materials and physically plausible supports. Straight orthographic projection, no perspective, no isometric tilt. Center full footprint with transparent margin and no clipping, labels, shadow, or detached guide pixels. Crisp pixel art.
